subject.title: Bug: OpenClaw 2026.4.9 exposes agent internal thinking (English) to user

question: Should maintainers approve a narrow core streaming-sanitizer fix for attribute-bearing thinking tags despite the security-sensitive no-new-fix-pr state?
rationale: The source-level repair shape is clear, but this issue is marked no-new-fix-pr and needs-security-review because hidden reasoning can cross into external chat recipients.

options.title: Approve narrow scanner fix
options.body: Update the embedded scanner and tests while preserving explicit reasoning-stream behavior and code-literal preservation.

options.title: Fold into broader leak policy work
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the fix to land only as part of the broader channel/intermediate-text leak effort.

options.title: Wait for live channel proof
options.body: Require a fresh WeChat or equivalent channel reproduction before any code change proceeds.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow scanner fix
recommendation.body: Update the embedded scanner and tests while preserving explicit reasoning-stream behavior and code-literal preservation.
